reason: Receipt scanning is the whole reason to pay, and I have never seen an app read Arabic receipts properly, so I would be paying for a feature I don't believe in. The free part is fine to try, but I hate subscriptions and my helper does a lot of the cooking, so I would not keep paying monthly.
objection: Receipt scanning never reads Arabic receipts properly, so the paid part would not work on my receipts and I'd still be typing everything in.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial or a clear demo showing it correctly reading a real Arabic or mixed Arabic/English Gulf supermarket receipt, plus a refund if it fails on mine.
